newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-BROKEN HAND FORCES KAFELNIKOV OUT OF OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-BROKEN HAND FORCES KAFELNIKOV OUT OF OPEN.

text.p: World tennis number four Yevgeny Kafelnikov on Friday withdrew from the Australian Open because tournament of a broken hand in a further blow to tournament organisers.
The 22-year-old Russian, seeded four, fractured a bone in his right hand to join American Monica Seles as a notable enforced absentee in Melbourne, Open organisers said.
"(The injury) was believed to be sustained during his gym work," Australian Open tournament referee Peter Bellenger said.
Kafelnikov, the French Open champion, has been playing in an exhibition warm-up event at Kooyong this week.
His position in the men's singles draw at the Open has been given to American MaliVai Washington, the highest ranked non-seed.
A qualifier will, in turn, take Washington's original place in the first round draw, made at the National Tennis Centre on Friday.
Seles, the world number two behind Germany's Steffi Graf, was forced to pull out with a broken finger.
